column1: # The KatWork CLI and web builds leave the WebAssembly plug-in host (photocraft-plugins, wasmi) out.
# The second web crate (it loads the wasm in parts) never held the host: vacuous rows, kept so a change is seen.
# The gated crates themselves: each defaults to the host (an upstream build of the crate alone keeps it).
# craft's font store with its downloader (craft-font-store, ureq; gate `font-download`).
# The web interface's font picker and Glyphs panel use craft's font manager, which holds the store's
# built-in index (craft-font-store stays); its downloader (ureq) is native only: a vacuous row.
